chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 579 – The Dice’s Final Siege: War Drums Sound Over Shangjing
chapter_meta_description: The Dice rallies the Great Liang army against our heroes. Bai Lingmiao reveals a new, unsettling side as the war drums begin to beat. A siege of lies and iron begins.
og_title: Chapter 579: War Drums – The Siege of Shangjing Begins
og_description: The false emperor’s army surrounds Shangjing, and Li Huowang vows to kill the Dice. Bai Lingmiao’s transformation deepens in this explosive siege chapter.
twitter_description: The Dice uses the entire Great Liang army as his weapon. Li Huowang makes a blood oath. The siege begins.

lore_anchors.definition: A Siming who presides over the Way of Compassion; a real deity in the Dao-Twisted World, not a delusion, whose touch conveys pure, maternal love—though her nature may have recently shifted.
A high-ranking Zuowandao member who uses “truth-lies” and currently sits on the Dragon Throne of Great Liang; his power is both political and conceptual.
A rare human constitution that makes the bearer a living point of ontological instability; valued as an alchemical ingredient and a weapon by those who know what it truly is.
The head of the Supervisory Heavenly Office, a government body that polices supernatural threats; his true motives are opaque, and he is willing to use Li Huowang as a tool.
The geomantic and metaphysical life-force of a dynasty; the Dice has seized it to legitimize his claim to the throne.
A heavily armored elite cavalry unit; in this siege, they are being launched by catapult onto the city walls as living projectiles.
